items.question: How much does window tinting cost?

items.question: Is window tint legal in Nevada?
items.answer: Yes, within limits. In Nevada, front side windows must let through not less than 35 percent of light, counting the glass and the film together, the windshield can only carry a strip across the very top, and your back and rear windows can be tinted as long as the vehicle has outside mirrors on both sides. We install fully legal tint and can recommend the darkest legal shade. Source: Nevada Revised Statutes 484D.440.
